context: Riku-teen and Sho-young try a new strategy game together; debate tactics.
purpose: Two teens engaged in strategy discussion gaming.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 陸くん、どうやって勝つ?
lines.style: Soft, genuinely curious. Leans forward slightly. The question of someone younger asking someone he respects. No rush—just wanting to understand.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 戦略立ててから、進めや。
lines.en: You gotta think it through first, then make your move.
lines.style: Relaxed, matter-of-fact. A light shrug in the voice. Not lecturing—just sharing what he knows. Warm enough that Sho feels invited to ask more.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: So you need a plan, huh?
lines.style: Quiet realization dawning. Speaking more to himself than to Riku. Soft and thoughtful—the moment when understanding clicks into place.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 頭使うゲーム、好きやろ?
lines.en: You like games where you actually have to think, right?
lines.style: Gentle tease with warmth underneath. A slight smile in the voice. Testing whether Sho knows what he enjoys, not doubting him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Yeah—thinking about it is so fun!
lines.style: Bright and unguarded. The energy lifts noticeably. Simple joy without self-consciousness. A kid genuinely delighted by something he's discovered.
